description: This file defines an enumeration HostingEnvironment that specifies different hosting environments such as CLOUD, DOCKER, DEVELOPMENT, and FILE_BASED, including associated config file suffixes and related constants.

classes.name: HostingEnvironment
classes.description: Enumeration of known hosting environments with suffixes for config files.

methods.name: getConfigFileSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix that distinguishes the config file for this particular hosting environment.
